tools.name: search_diamonds
tools.description: Search Ada Diamonds' live loose lab grown diamond inventory by shape, carat weight, price, color, clarity, and cut. Returns currently available stones with their grading report numbers and product URLs. Use this for any question about what diamond a budget can buy. MCP Apps-enabled: hosts that support MCP Apps render the results as an interactive card grid.

shape.description: Cut shape: Round, Oval, Cushion, Emerald, Pear, Radiant, Asscher, Princess, or Marquise

min_price.description: Minimum price of the loose stone in US dollars

max_price.description: Maximum price of the loose stone in US dollars

clarity.description: Clarity grade: FL, IF, VVS1, VVS2, VS1, VS2, SI1, or SI2

cut.description: Cut grade: Ideal, Excellent, or Very Good

sort.description: Result order: price_asc (default relevance), price_desc, carat_asc, or carat_desc

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return, 1 to 50 (default 10)

context.description: Explain in 15-25 words, in third person, why this tool is called and how it supports the user's goal. For analytics only. You MUST describe only the abstract purpose of the tool call. NEVER include, repeat, paraphrase, or infer personal, sensitive, or identifying information from the user request or tool results, including names, emails, phone numbers, IPs, IDs, or credentials. You MUST generalize specific entities into roles such as "a user", "the customer", or "an account". Example: "Retrieving a customer's recent orders to investigate a billing issue and help support determine the appropriate resolution."

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Assemble a cart and get a Stripe-hosted checkout URL the customer opens to pay; no card data passes through the agent. Item ids come from the search tools (`diamond:<report>`, `setting:<slug>`, `jewelry:<slug>`); a complete ring is one setting plus one diamond. Needs the shipping address (prices tax and shipping into the link). Expires after 24 hours. No credential needed. Without a production credential this tool runs in the sandbox: the link is simulated and no Stripe session is created. Pass `env: "production"` when the customer actually wants to buy — that returns a live, payable link.

id.description: Catalog item id: `diamond:<report number>`, `setting:<slug>`, or `jewelry:<slug>` (from search_diamonds / search_engagement_rings / search_jewelry results)

items.description: Items to buy; a complete ring is one setting plus one diamond

state.description: State or region code, e.g. NY

shipping_address.description: Where the order ships; used to price tax and shipping into the link

buyer_email.description: Buyer email for the receipt; Stripe collects it on the payment page when omitted

env.description: sandbox returns a simulated link and creates no Stripe session; production mints a live, payable Stripe Checkout link. Defaults to sandbox for anonymous callers and to the credential's environment otherwise. A sandbox credential is always sandbox.
